unknown-publisher.name: Publisher rights not reviewed
unknown-publisher.attribution: Retain publisher, author, date and original link; this is not a licence.
unknown-publisher.redistribution: No republication, export or retained-excerpt grant established.
unknown-publisher.notes: RSS availability and a source link do not establish commercial, hosted, AI or republication rights. Review this publisher and underlying contributors individually.

unknown-source.name: Provider rights not reviewed
unknown-source.attribution: Preserve source identity and record-level credits pending review.
unknown-source.notes: Existing code licence notes are leads, not independently verified rights. Review the exact data product, service contract and intended use.

camera-owner-rights.name: Camera owner and host rights not reviewed
camera-owner-rights.licence: Index metadata and camera media have separate rights
camera-owner-rights.attribution: Keep each camera owner and provider credit; do not substitute directory credit.
camera-owner-rights.redistribution: Public stream/embed URLs and an allowlisted host do not authorise copying, proxying, capture, resale or report export.
camera-owner-rights.notes: Review each host, camera owner and delivery method. OSIRIS MIT catalogue code/data notices do not license third-party streams. A directory or government index does not establish rights in every image.

mixed-evidence.name: Mixed or user-supplied evidence
mixed-evidence.attribution: Preserve originating author/provider, licence and any required notices.
mixed-evidence.redistribution: Each selected item retains its own restrictions; combining it into a report grants no new rights.
mixed-evidence.notes: Applies to uploads, retained feeds, mixed curated assets and web-search evidence. Review source-specific licences, privacy, image rights and onward use.

cloudflare-radar.name: Cloudflare Radar API data
cloudflare-radar.attribution: Credit Cloudflare Radar, source link and CC BY-NC 4.0; identify changes.
cloudflare-radar.redistribution: Non-commercial sharing subject to the licence. Commercial display/export needs a separate grant.
cloudflare-radar.notes: API data is distinct from CC BY 4.0 embeddable/downloadable graphs. Non-commercial hosted suitability is fact-specific; no project exception verified.

ooni.name: OONI data
ooni.attribution: Credit OONI, link source and licence, identify changes.
ooni.redistribution: Non-commercial sharing/adaptations subject to attribution and share-alike; no commercial grant verified.
ooni.notes: The acknowledgement setting records an operator assertion, not permission. Review whether the actual hosted use is non-commercial and the effect on derived outputs.

adsb-fi.name: adsb.fi open data
adsb-fi.attribution: Cite adsb.fi and link its home page.
adsb-fi.redistribution: No licensing, sale, rental or lease of the data/service under the public terms.
adsb-fi.notes: Commercial enquiries are invited. Current aviation code uses adsb.lol instead; do not confuse the providers or assume personal use covers team hosting.

adsb-lol.name: ADSB.lol API data
adsb-lol.attribution: Credit ADSB.lol and ODbL; preserve database notices.
adsb-lol.redistribution: ODbL attribution/share-alike and derivative-database obligations apply.
adsb-lol.notes: The API page specifies ODbL. Its separate contributor CC0 grant is not a replacement API-output licence. Review derived databases and publication; no availability guarantee.

deepstate.name: DeepState API
deepstate.licence: Provider API licence; commercial use by prior agreement
deepstate.attribution: Preserve DeepState identification and approved links/branding.
deepstate.redistribution: API distribution, publication, proxying or transfer is restricted without authorisation.
deepstate.notes: Visual/text material reuse rules are separate from API rights. Hosted cache/display and exports require express scope confirmation; no grant verified.

eox-2024.name: EOxCloudless 2024
eox-2024.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 or suitable EOX commercial licence
eox-2024.attribution: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2024).
eox-2024.redistribution: Preserve visible attribution; independent downstream reuse/sublicensing needs scope review.
eox-2024.notes: 2018–2025 imagery is non-commercial under published free terms. The 2016 CC BY offer does not cover the implemented 2024 layer. Map export declarations are not licence verification.

independent-rss.name: The Independent RSS
independent-rss.attribution: Keep publisher notices and links; agreed licensing credit remains unverified.
independent-rss.redistribution: Republication needs licensing; general terms restrict network storage accessible to others.
independent-rss.notes: Request hosted display, selected-excerpt retention and report-export permission before relying on these uses.

cna-rss.name: CNA RSS
cna-rss.attribution: Direct link to the full article; no intermediate page; preserve supplied content.
cna-rss.redistribution: Third-party distribution, forwarding, licensing and transfer restricted, including non-commercial use.
cna-rss.notes: Attribution alone does not authorise multi-user redistribution. Seek a separate content-hosting agreement.

reddit.name: Reddit Data API
reddit.licence: Data API Terms and Responsible Builder Policy
reddit.attribution: Developer-policy attribution and owner restrictions; exact display specification needs review.
reddit.redistribution: Only approved app use; limited display rights are not general resale or independent redistribution.
reddit.notes: Current policy requires API approval and written commercial approval. Retention, deletion and sensitive inference need review. No current catalogue connector.

open-meteo.name: Open-Meteo data and service
open-meteo.licence: CC BY 4.0 data; free API non-commercial; commercial service subscription
open-meteo.attribution: Credit Open-Meteo beside displayed data, link source/licence and identify changes.
open-meteo.redistribution: Data redistribution is allowed under CC BY 4.0; API subscription/access conditions still apply.
open-meteo.notes: Commercial calls to the free API are not authorised by the open data licence. Paid entitlement is unverified; no current catalogue connector.

gfw.name: Global Fishing Watch
gfw.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 default plus service/dataset terms
gfw.attribution: Source/access date, licence and provider notices; include the specified apparent-fishing disclaimer where applicable.
gfw.redistribution: Non-commercial reuse is conditional and dataset-specific; terms additionally address same-term reuse.
gfw.notes: API/bulk registration is not commercial permission. Third-party data and hosted audience need review; software Apache licensing is not a data grant.

opensanctions.name: OpenSanctions
opensanctions.licence: Public CC BY-NC 4.0; separate API/bulk commercial contracts
opensanctions.attribution: CC credit/link/change notice for public data; confirm paid-contract requirements.
opensanctions.redistribution: Bulk internal, bulk reseller and API grants differ. Substantial standalone dataset redistribution is restricted.
opensanctions.notes: Current paid API terms contemplate customer-facing products; do not apply the bulk internal-only rule to that contract. No purchased entitlement or catalogue connector verified.

acled.name: ACLED event data
acled.attribution: Prominent ACLED credit, access date, data scope and changes, including visualisations.
acled.redistribution: Raw sharing restricted. Non-commercial external outputs must be transformative and prevent dataset reconstruction; a dashboard alone is insufficient.
acled.notes: Corporate/public-sector and third-party-service permissions require the appropriate agreement. Account/API entitlement is not redistribution permission.

openfreemap.name: OpenFreeMap maps
openfreemap.licence: Commercial use stated; OSM/ODbL and OpenMapTiles rights remain
openfreemap.attribution: OpenFreeMap (optional), © OpenMapTiles, Data from OpenStreetMap; retain links and printed/export credit.
openfreemap.redistribution: Observe underlying data/style licences and ODbL. Service terms do not grant unrestricted bulk extraction.
openfreemap.notes: Commercial web/app maps expressly contemplated. Public service has no SLA; reconcile automated bulk collection with service terms. Existing image export must retain credits.

osm.name: OpenStreetMap data
osm.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; link copyright/ODbL and preserve required notices.
osm.redistribution: Data/derivative-database share-alike conditions differ from produced-work image attribution.
osm.notes: Data rights do not grant unlimited use of OSM or third-party tile/geocoding/routing servers. Review service policy separately.

osm-service.name: OSM-derived public service
osm-service.licence: ODbL data; service entitlement not reviewed
osm-service.redistribution: Data licence does not settle hosted service quotas, result caching or redistribution.
osm-service.notes: Photon/Valhalla/Overpass are separate operators. Review exact public-instance terms or self-host before approving commercial service use.

natural-earth.name: Natural Earth
natural-earth.attribution: Credit optional; suggested: Made with Natural Earth.
natural-earth.redistribution: Electronic and printed redistribution and modification permitted.
natural-earth.notes: The provider explicitly permits commercial use. This does not settle third-party overlays or jurisdiction-specific boundary presentation.

wikidata-mixed.name: Wikidata plus separately licensed media
wikidata-mixed.licence: Structured data CC0; other text/media separate
wikidata-mixed.attribution: Wikidata credit useful; preserve individual Commons author/licence/change notices.
wikidata-mixed.redistribution: CC0 facts do not license linked portraits, photographs, prose or curated source material.
wikidata-mixed.notes: Review every included image and seed source before approving the whole mixed catalogue. Do not label the complete asset CC0.

govuk.name: GOV.UK published content
govuk.licence: OGL v3 for covered content, with exceptions
govuk.attribution: Attribute the originating department and OGL; identify third-party material.
govuk.redistribution: Reuse covered Crown content under OGL; exclude content carrying separate rights.
govuk.notes: GOV.UK permits feed reuse. Service-specific terms, personal data, logos and third-party rights still need review.

ecb.name: ECB reference rates and releases
ecb.attribution: Cite ECB, reproduce accurately and identify modifications.
ecb.redistribution: Sold documents require notice before payment and at access that ECB information is freely available; authored papers have separate restrictions.
ecb.notes: Reference rates are informational, not transaction prices. Apply the free-source notice to relevant commercial reports/subscriptions.

gleif.name: GLEIF LEI data
gleif.attribution: GLEIF provenance recommended; no CC0 attribution condition.
gleif.redistribution: CC0 reuse of covered LEI data; service terms and unrelated materials remain separate.
gleif.notes: No licence claim is made for linked company filings or third-party source documents.

openalex.name: OpenAlex metadata
openalex.attribution: OpenAlex provenance recommended; retain original publication/DOI references.
openalex.redistribution: Metadata reuse permitted; this does not relicense linked full text or images.
openalex.notes: Data openness does not establish a particular API tier or allowance.

crossref.name: Crossref metadata
crossref.licence: Metadata reuse without restriction, as described by Crossref
crossref.attribution: Preserve Crossref provenance, authors and DOI links.
crossref.redistribution: Metadata access is not a grant to republish linked full articles or third-party images.
crossref.notes: Review any source-specific copyrighted abstract/full-text field before exporting more than the implemented metadata.

digitraffic.name: Fintraffic Digitraffic
digitraffic.licence: CC BY 4.0 data and service terms
digitraffic.attribution: Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, licence CC BY 4.0; identify changes.
digitraffic.redistribution: Covered data may be reused with licence conditions; verify any third-party exception.
digitraffic.notes: Review camera-image scope separately where contributor rights differ; preserve rate limits and service identification.

usgs.name: USGS-produced data
usgs.licence: US public-domain USGS-produced data; third-party exceptions
usgs.attribution: Credit USGS and retain third-party notices where present.
usgs.redistribution: USGS-produced information reusable; non-USGS images and other supplied materials can retain copyright.
usgs.notes: This assessment covers earthquake observations, not a blanket licence for every linked page or image.

nasa-data.name: NASA Earth science products
nasa-data.licence: NASA-led mission data CC0 unless marked otherwise; contributor exceptions
nasa-data.attribution: Use product-specific NASA/LANCE/FIRMS/GIBS credit and dataset citation.
nasa-data.redistribution: Check each product or contributing source restriction; no blanket NASA-site clearance.
nasa-data.notes: General policy located, but per-product and EONET contributing-source terms need completion. The older Worldview copyright URL was inaccessible in this lookup.

mitre.name: MITRE ATT&CK
mitre.attribution: Retain MITRE copyright designation and full licence in copies.
mitre.redistribution: Research/development/commercial copying permitted with the specified notices.
mitre.notes: Trademark/branding and third-party linked reports remain separate.

telegram.name: Telegram content
telegram.licence: Restricted platform content licence; owner rights remain
telegram.attribution: Retain channel/author and post link; credit is not permission.
telegram.redistribution: Non-standard access and transfer restricted. Content-owner conditions apply separately.
telegram.notes: The current terms broadly prohibit scraping/aggregation and use for AI development, enhancement or deployment without specific consent. Legal review needed for existing collectors, model input and frozen report evidence.

youtube.name: YouTube Data API metadata
youtube.licence: YouTube API terms and developer policies
youtube.attribution: YouTube-required branding/links and uploader attribution; review exact presentation.
youtube.redistribution: Non-authorised API data requires delete/refresh within 30 days; redistribution and independent media reuse are not blanket permissions.
youtube.notes: Review saved evidence, exports, retention/deletion and application privacy/terms before approving use. A key alone does not establish compliance.

bluesky.name: Bluesky user content
bluesky.attribution: Preserve author, post URL and platform identity.
bluesky.redistribution: Bluesky platform licences do not establish blanket third-party report/export rights.
bluesky.notes: Review developer terms, deletion propagation and individual author rights; AT Protocol accessibility is not a public-domain dedication.

ioda.name: IODA public data
ioda.licence: Terms not extractable from current page
ioda.attribution: Credit IODA/Georgia Tech and originating measurements pending exact terms.
ioda.redistribution: No verified commercial or hosted redistribution grant.
ioda.notes: Lookup returned only a logo. Existing research acknowledgement is not permission; live feed paths have different gates.

gdelt.name: GDELT datasets
gdelt.attribution: Cite GDELT and link its website.
gdelt.redistribution: Dataset redistribution, mirrors and commercial use permitted under the published terms.
gdelt.notes: This covers GDELT data, not copyright in linked news articles, photographs or publisher excerpts.

nws.name: NOAA National Weather Service data
nws.licence: Public domain for NWS-produced information unless otherwise noted
nws.attribution: Retain notices; credit NWS; do not imply endorsement or present modified data as official.
nws.redistribution: Lawful reuse permitted for covered NWS data; third-party material requires separate review.
nws.notes: Applies to NWS/NHC/SWPC/tsunami information, not every item hosted anywhere on noaa.gov.

geoboundaries.name: geoBoundaries
geoboundaries.attribution: Credit geoBoundaries and its requested Runfola et al. (2020) citation.
geoboundaries.redistribution: Commercial reuse and redistribution with attribution, licence notice and indication of changes.
geoboundaries.notes: Confirm the packaged boundary release and preserve its source-specific metadata.

wri-power.name: WRI Global Power Plant Database
wri-power.attribution: Credit WRI Global Power Plant Database and link licence/source.
wri-power.redistribution: Database reuse with CC BY conditions; retain provenance and identify alterations.
wri-power.notes: Latest published database version is 1.3.0; maintenance stopped. Software MIT is separate from data rights.

viina.name: VIINA territorial-control data
viina.attribution: Retain VIINA notices and follow the README citation requirements.
viina.redistribution: ODbL attribution/share-alike and access to adapted databases may apply to public outputs.
viina.notes: Review the exact adapted snapshot and report exports. Linked publishers retain separate article rights.

celestrak.name: CelesTrak service usage
celestrak.licence: Usage policy reviewed; commercial redistribution licence not established
celestrak.attribution: Retain CelesTrak and upstream provenance pending rights clarification.
celestrak.redistribution: Free service access does not by itself establish downstream licensing rights.
celestrak.notes: Policy updated 22 May 2026: download once per update (GP every two hours); stop on non-200 responses. Check scheduler/backoff compliance separately.

bbc-rss.name: BBC RSS
bbc-rss.licence: Current terms lookup blocked; older BBC terms available
bbc-rss.attribution: Older terms require prominent BBC News name and linked source; preserve embedded branding.
bbc-rss.redistribution: No current commercial or multi-user grant verified; do not treat historical personal-use terms as clearance.
bbc-rss.notes: Current page blocked by robots. Official September 2022 PDF section 15 requires permission for business RSS and a metadata licence. Confirm current scope before use.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.redistribution: Commercial aggregation and AI reuse require approval.

bls.name: US Bureau of Labor Statistics
bls.attribution: Cite BLS; do not use its emblem without authority.

bls.notes: BLS permits reuse of its public-domain publications; emblem and previously copyrighted images are excluded.

google-news.redistribution: No project-specific onward-sharing or export grant established.

dw-rss.name: Deutsche Welle RSS

france24.name: France 24
